results.text: Good day, and thank you for standing by. [#0](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-0)
Welcome to the Elis Full Year 2024 Results Conference Call. [#1](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-1)
[Operator Instructions] Please be advised that today's conference is being recorded. [#2](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-2)
I would now like to hand the conference over to your speaker today, Xavier Martire, CEO. [#4](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-4)
Please go ahead. [#5](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-5)
Thank you. [#7](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-7)
Good morning, and welcome to Elis 2024 annual results presentation. [#8](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-8)
I'm Xavier Martire, CEO of Elis; and I'm here in Paris with our CFO, Louis Guyot. [#9](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-9)
After an overview of the highlights of the year for Elis, I will hand over to Louis. [#10](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-10)
He will detail the 2024 results. [#11](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-11)

I will then come back to provide you with an update on our CSR journey before detailing the new capital allocation strategy that we announced today as well as our outlook for 2025. [#12](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-12)
Finally, we'll have a Q&A session to answer your questions. [#14](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-14)
And our call, Nicolas Buron, will be available to answer any of your questions off-line. [#15](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-15)
Before we start, please take the time to read the disclaimer. [#17](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-17)

So 2024 was another good vintage for Elis, both operationally and financially, and the group delivered record performance across all financial KPIs. [#19](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-19)

Top line momentum remained very solid with growth of plus 6.1%, of which 5.2% on an organic basis to reach a record of nearly EUR 4.6 billion. [#20](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-20)
EBITDA reached EUR 1.6 billion, up 9.2% and the EBITDA margin was up plus 100 basis points at 35.2%. [#21](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-21)
EBIT was up 7.3% at EUR 733 million, with the EBIT margin up plus 20 bps at 16%. [#23](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-23)

Net income was up 29% to EUR 338 million, and headline net income per share was up 3% with a record level of EUR 1.76 on a fully diluted basis. [#24](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-24)
Return on capital employed also reached a record level at 14.5%, posting a 60 basis point improvement. [#25](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-25)

Finally, free cash flow reached EUR 346 million, showing a 14% improvement year-on-year, and the financial leverage ratio decreased by 0.2x to 1.85x at the end of December 2024. [#26](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-26)
The remarkable '24 financial achievements are the result of Elis' great commercial and industrial efficiency throughout the year. [#28](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-28)

In particular, our organic performance was achieved through very high service quality standards, resulting in a decrease in churn along with many commercial successes and pricing adjustments to reflect cost base inflation. [#29](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-29)

We also continued to deliver productivity gains on every operating cost line, and you will see later in this presentation that the EBITDA margin improved in all geographies with an especially remarkable performance in Germany, our second largest country. [#30](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-30)

Finally, we pursued our bolt-on M&A strategy to consolidate our existing footprints, and we also further broaden our frontiers as we enter Malaysia, paving the way for future growth opportunities. [#31](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-31)
The next slide provides a bridge between 2023 and 2024 revenue which increased plus 6% year-on-year to a record EUR 4.6 billion. [#33](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-33)

The 5.2% organic revenue growth was driven by the success of the commercial initiatives we put in place across the board, along with the strengthening of our sales force. [#34](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-34)

At the same time, top-notch quality of service, combined with solid commercial relationships, allowed us to lower our churn and to come back to a normative level after a slight blip in 2023. [#35](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-35)

Pricing also contributed to 2024 revenue growth with our pricing policy aiming to offset the inflation of our cost base, which was mainly driven by the increase in salaries. [#36](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-36)
In hospitality, the picture was slightly disappointing with the Paris Olympics having, as we expected, a negative effect on activity. [#38](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-38)
That said, the end of the year was better oriented. [#39](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-39)

M&A had a plus 1.2% impact on '24 of the growth corresponding to plus EUR 52 million uplift essentially driven by 2 acquisitions in the Netherlands. [#41](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-41)
Lastly, FX minus 0.3% impact on revenue, mostly due to the negative evolution of the Brazilian real. [#43](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-43)
Moving on to the next slide, our hold net growth benefited and with continued benefit from positive market trends across our regions. [#45](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-45)

First of all, the COVID as well as the many sections over the last decade, especially in food industry have resulted in a higher demand for hygiene and protective equipment for workers. [#46](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-46)

Secondly, our growth in the health care business has been, and will continue to be, correlated with the hedging of population in both Europe and Latin America. [#47](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-47)

Third, the continued development of tourism directly drives our hospitality activity, the new trends encompass sustainable tourism, responsible travel. [#48](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-48)

Hotel groups are addressing these new clients' needs through modernization of infrastructure and use of circular services such as those proposed by Elis. [#49](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-49)

Fourth, the growing need for [ comfortability ] of professional workwear as well as European regulations resulted in a steady development of outsourcing. [#51](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-51)
Last, we see more and more tenders coming with one or several CSR criteria, especially in Central and Northern Europe. [#53](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-53)

Our circular services perfectly address these evolving needs, and it is clearly way more advanced on that front that all its competitors creating a competitive edge and room for growth. [#54](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-54)

These underlying trends, combined with the commercial initiative we put in place, contributed to the many commercial successes we recorded in 2024. [#56](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-56)
At the end of the day, our goal is to replicate the French footprint and service range in other geographies. [#57](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-57)

When the scale and density of our operations is adequate, we can start addressing smaller-sized clients, as we have in Brazil and U.K. with excellent results. [#58](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-58)

Similarly, we also regularly expand our pest control and clean room offers to new geographies as they continue to benefit from a very favorable post-COVID effect the increasing need for hygiene in general. [#60](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-60)

These 2 businesses -- look -- similarly, we also regularly spend our pest control and clean room offers to new geographies as they continue to benefit from a very favorable post-COVID effects with an increasing need for hygiene in general. [#61](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-61)

These 2 businesses delivered combined organic revenue growth of more than 10% in '24 to reach cumulative revenue of close to EUR 330 million. [#62](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-62)
I will provide you with more detail on these 2 businesses on the next slide. [#63](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-63)

Furthermore, we continue to see first time outsourcing some specific industries, such as nothing home in Spain and in the U.K. which were historically very fragmented markets with a lack of professionalization and market standards. [#65](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-65)
Of course, all the opportunities I have just listed don't happen by themselves. [#66](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-66)
We are being proactive by launching dedicated offers and a specific sales force to save them. [#67](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-67)
Moving on to the next slide. [#69](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-69)
2024 was a very good year on the quality of service fronts, which is, by far, the most important factor for client retention. [#70](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-70)

We monitor client satisfaction using a range of tools, an independent department at a discounted tens of thousands of direct interviews every year. [#71](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-71)
In 2024, we reached a recost. [#72](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-72)
The score closed to 90%, a record level. [#73](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-73)
These good results are essential as quality of service and supply reliability are key differentiating factors on the market. [#74](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-74)
It is leveraging strong network density to deliver best-in-class service. [#75](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-75)
Moving on to the next slide. [#77](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-77)

We'd like to provide an update on our pest control and clean room businesses, which delivered another year of double-digit expansion and significantly contributed to Elis' overall growth. [#78](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-78)
Let's first have a look at our clean room business, which posted 2024 revenue of EUR 255 million, up plus 11% for the year. [#79](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-79)
We are, by, far the largest European player in that field with a network of 33 clean rooms. [#80](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-80)

We offer a large variety of products with the pharmaceutical and microelectronic industries, such as reusable clean room garment, cleaning systems, goggles and related contamination control solutions. [#81](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-81)

Our existing client base provides us with many cross-selling opportunities in this very technical and highly profitable markets where the capacity to innovate is a key differentiating factor. [#82](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-82)

Additionally, One Way is a small acquisition in Malaysia announced in 2024, offers interesting prospects with our international clients and reinforce Elis leadership position in the global clean room market. [#84](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-84)
As far as pest control is concerned, 2024's revenue came at EUR 75 million, up 24% year-on-year, a large part of that being organic. [#86](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-86)
Pest control is a perfect example of a margin-accretive service that we added into our portfolio. [#87](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-87)

Over time, we have signed many pest control contracts with existing customers, leveraging our strong customer relationships and second to none network density. [#88](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-88)

Over the last decade, we have developed our pest control network through small bolt-on acquisitions, helping local platforms able to address more and more clients in our geographies. [#89](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-89)
Today, we propose our pest control services in 10 countries with around 380 specialized technicians. [#90](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-90)

The business unit has, at the same time, worked to develop the innovative traceability and prevention solutions as well as more responsible alternative approach. [#92](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-92)
In some countries, the offering is also now available to individual customers. [#93](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-93)

Over time, pest controls has also increased its level of professionalism, and we believe our technical knowhow is comparable to what pure pest control players are offering. [#94](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-94)
Moving on to the next slide. [#96](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-96)
Productivity gains were a significant driver of the margin improvement delivered in '24. [#97](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-97)

And logistics is an area where Elis has been significantly progressing over the last few years, leveraging into non-industrial expertise. [#98](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-98)

Central industrial team defines and updates a set of best practices that are rolled out across our countries, benchmarking every plant to assess to efficiency. [#99](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-99)

These results in recurring productivity gains of between 2% and 4% per year workshops, all in terms of resource consumption like energy, water or washing products. [#100](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-100)
In '24, we improved the workshop productivity by 2% for both workwear and [ Platinum ]. [#101](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-101)

Here, the KPI used are the number of kilogram wash per hour per employee for Platinum and the number of uniforms washed per hour per employee for workwear. [#102](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-102)

On top of that improvement, we also managed to decrease water and gas consumption by minus 4% and minus 3%, respectively, compared to 2023. [#103](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-103)
Let's now take a look at each of our geographies. [#105](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-105)
First, where revenue growth was entirely organic at plus 3.3% in 2024 and margin was up 150 bps at the record level of 41.8%. [#106](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-106)

Top line growth was driven by commercial momentum in workwear, especially for Industry and Trade & Services and by pricing adjustments to offset the inflation of our costs, essentially salary linked. [#107](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-107)
Hospitality activity was subdued due to the production of different headwinds. [#108](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-108)
In June were impacted by poor weather. [#109](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-109)
June then was impacted by the Olympic preparations in Paris and the generalization with somewhat limited weak countries. [#110](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-110)
July and August were impacted by the Olympics with professional events such as company seminars, reschedule or canceled. [#111](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-111)
However, on a positive note, we noted a rebound in occupancy rate at the end of the year, and the beginning of '25 is satisfactory. [#112](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-112)

The impressive plus 150 bps improvement in the EBITDA margin was driven by further rollout of efficiency road maps on our industrial and logistics workflows. [#113](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-113)
We also benefited from the lower cost of paper consumable in our washroom business. [#114](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-114)
Move on to the next slide. [#116](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-116)
Central Europe delivered a strong performance, notably due to significant progress recorded in Germany. [#117](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-117)
Revenue growth was strong at plus 12.3%, and the EBITDA margin posted a 180 basis point improvement to 32.3%. [#118](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-118)

Despite the adverse [indiscernible] of [indiscernible] demonstrated again strong resilience with organic growth of plus 7.5%, driven by good commercial momentum in workwear across the board. [#119](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-119)

Additionally, the acquisition of Moderna and Vastned in the Netherlands contributed plus 4.3% to the region growth in 2024 and enabled Elis to enter the Dutch hospitality market. [#120](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-120)
The EBITDA margin showed significant improvement, up plus 180 bps compared to the same period last year at 32.3%. [#121](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-121)

Again, Germany was especially strong with margin improving by an impressive 450 bps, driven by our pricing discipline, productivity gains and better energy purchasing conditions. [#122](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-122)
Let me focus further on this remarkable performance by moving on to the next slide. [#124](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-124)
With revenue slightly above EUR 600 million, Germany is our second largest market after France. [#125](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-125)
And since 2017, a massive workload of integration has been undertaken to merge Elis and Berendsen networks. [#126](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-126)

A part of this integration work -- a part of this integration work, sorry, we have invested in high-quality teams in the field and in better industrial assets, while rationalizing our IT systems. [#127](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-127)

The plus 22% increase in minimum living wage at the end of '22, together with the surge in energy prices, had a significant impact on our margin in '22 and '23. [#128](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-128)

We eventually managed to adjust our prices to offset that, and the significant growth in workwear high-profitability business enable us to reverse the margin curve in 2024. [#129](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-129)
Germany now stands at 29% EBITDA margin, and the country should continue it towards the group's average margin in coming years. [#130](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-130)
Moving on to the next slide. [#132](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-132)

We're in active with bolt-on M&A in Central Europe, and we strengthened our footprint in the Netherlands with 2 very interesting acquisitions. [#133](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-133)

In the first half, we acquired Berna, EUR 50 million top line business, which provides flat and workwear and agile and well-being services clients in the hospitality industry and trade services industry. [#134](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-134)
Moderna has superb industrial assets with a lot of spare capacity, which we'll use for future development. [#135](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-135)

This first acquisition was complemented in the second half by the acquisition of Vastned, EUR 7 million business whose industrial assets are also particularly upscale. [#136](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-136)

These 2 acquisitions have enhanced Elis network in the Netherlands in the group to address a flatline market in the country, which was not the case before. [#137](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-137)
As you can imagine, they also bring significant synergies that our teams have been working on extracting since the closing. [#138](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-138)
Moving on to the next slide. [#140](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-140)
So organic growth and margin in Scandinavia and Eastern Europe are solid. [#141](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-141)
It is the only region where margin declined in 2024. [#142](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-142)

Organic growth was satisfactory at nearly plus 4%, driven by the commercial [indiscernible] we implemented to our net outsourcing opportunity in the region, but the EBITDA margin was down 120 bps, also remaining at 35.3%, so a very high level. [#143](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-143)
We noted a tougher competitive environment in Denmark. [#144](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-144)

In addition, pricing negotiations were sometimes more difficult, notably with customers from the public health care sector where contractual indexes were below the actual inflation of our cost base. [#145](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-145)
Finally, Sweden was impacted by the bankruptcy of Northvolt, large clients in our industry and market. [#146](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-146)
Moving on to the next slide. [#148](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-148)
U.K. and Ireland posted further progress in 2024. [#149](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-149)

Organic growth came at plus 4.3% as the reinforcement of our sales team paid off with many successes for both health care and industry clients. [#150](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-150)
Pricing was also a significant top line growth driver in the context of a significant minimum wage increase in the region. [#151](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-151)

The EBITDA margin delivered 90 basis point improvement to reach 31.6% with a favorable evolution in our energy purchasing conditions as well as continuous positive gains on industrial processes and logistics. [#152](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-152)
Moving on to the next slide. [#154](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-154)

Performance in Latin America was also very satisfactory with organic revenue growth at 8.7%, acting as a real growth engine for the group. [#155](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-155)

Latin America continues to offer many growth prospects with a steady outsourcing trend in workwear for industry and inflation for health care where we continue to see hospitals closing their internal laundries and switching to outsourcing. [#156](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-156)
The EBITDA margin increased another 50 bps to get to nearly 35%,  which is remarkable achievements. [#157](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-157)
Bear in mind, we started from 21% 10 years ago. [#158](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-158)

Moving on to the next slide, Southern Europe, delivered organic performance of plus 5.4%, driven by good commercial momentum in workwear and pest control and satisfactory activity in hospitality, both in Spain and in Portugal. [#160](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-160)

EBITDA margin was up plus 130 bps at 32.6% due to the volume of lift, the better partial condition of energy and further productivity date. [#161](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-161)

To the next slide, we also announced the acquisition of One Way in Malaysia in early July after 1.5 years of discussion with the family on One Way that was formed in native has around 200 employees and can address the entire management territory, thanks to 3 specialized laundries will provide reusable garment services in clean room to mainly international groups operating semiconductors, medical devices and chemicals. [#163](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-163)
In 2024, OneWay delivered revenue close to EUR 5 million. [#164](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-164)

It is, therefore, a small acquisition but with interesting prospects going forward, given the very strong momentum of the clean room market in Malaysia. [#165](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-165)
Additionally, this acquisition reinforce heavy [indiscernible] ships position in the global clean room market. [#166](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-166)
Moving on to the next slide to conclude on M&A. [#168](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-168)
We continue the consolidation of our existing position with 3 new bolt-ons consolidated since the 1st of January. [#169](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-169)

[indiscernible], EUR 10 million business in the Spanish hospitality market; [indiscernible] a EUR 19 million business in the German health care and hospitality markets; and Boden, a EUR 27 million business in Switzerland, serving the health care and hospitality market from 2 plants. [#170](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-170)
These are 3 typical bolt-on acquisitions that constitute a significant value creation lever for the group. [#171](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-171)
Let me now hand over to Louis who will give you more color on our 2024 financial performance. [#173](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003394029-173)
